title: Whopper wrapper / Ingredient field

location.series: JKR / Burger King identity case study

slide_intent: Use ingredient illustration to connect packaging with its contents so the wrapper participates in the food story.
strategic_value: Tomato, pickle and lettuce motifs can make Burger King’s wrapping recognizable even when folded.
demonstration: A wrapped burger sits over an opened illustrated sheet; large vegetables surround the center logo and vertical Whopper labels.
practical_value: Compare how a flat pattern survives folding around a product.

content_islands.name: Open wrapper
content_islands.spec: Fill the ground with oversized ingredient illustrations and edge product labels.

content_islands.name: Wrapped burger
content_islands.spec: Place the folded product near the center with the primary logo still visible.

reference_purposes.Application: The paired flat and folded wrapper demonstrates the same ingredient artwork before and after use.
